import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    payments = inputs["payments"].copy()

    # Ensure all expected columns exist
    for col in ["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country"]:
        if col not in payments.columns:
            payments[col] = pd.NA

    n = len(payments)
    reason_code = pd.Series([None] * n, index=payments.index, dtype=object)

    amount = payments["amount"]
    currency = payments["currency"]
    country = payments["country"]

    valid_currencies = {"USD", "EUR", "GBP"}

    # Masks for each rule
    r1_mask = amount.isna()

    r2_mask = (~r1_mask) & (amount <= 0)

    r3_mask = (~r1_mask) & (~r2_mask) & (~currency.isin(valid_currencies))

    r4_mask = (~r1_mask) & (~r2_mask) & (~r3_mask) & (country.isna())

    reason_code = reason_code.mask(r1_mask, "AMT_NULL")
    reason_code = reason_code.mask(r2_mask, "AMT_NONPOS")
    reason_code = reason_code.mask(r3_mask, "CCY_INVALID")
    reason_code = reason_code.mask(r4_mask, "CTRY_NULL")

    rejected_mask = reason_code.notna()
    passed_mask = ~rejected_mask

    # Build clean output
    clean = payments.loc[passed_mask].copy()
    clean["amount"] = clean["amount"].round(2)
    payments_clean = clean[["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country"]].reset_index(drop=True)

    # Build rejects output
    rejects = payments.loc[rejected_mask].copy()
    rejects["reason_code"] = reason_code.loc[rejected_mask]
    payments_rejects = rejects[["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country", "reason_code"]].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "payments_clean": payments_clean,
        "payments_rejects": payments_rejects,
    }
